metadata.bounds_meaning: Scores under selected assumptions, not confidence intervals or guaranteed physical bounds.
metadata.area_basis: Parcel area is a proxy unless contradicted; it is not measured usable area.

questions.prompt: Which grid figures should we use?
questions.help: Vendor alternatives apply only where official data is missing or predates June 30, 2026. Keep official data if it earns the same or more points. Estimates need operator confirmation.

options.label: Include vendor estimates
options.description: Explore the vendor's central estimate when allowed.

options.label: Explore vendor upside
options.description: Explore the upper end of the vendor's unvalidated ±40% band.

questions.prompt: How should we treat unknown or conditional local support?
questions.help: Known neutral or opposed positions stay unchanged. Choosing upside does not confirm support.

options.label: Explore confirmed support
options.description: Show ten points if support is confirmed and any condition is met.

questions.prompt: Should we explore sites with missing critical checks?
questions.help: This covers missing capacity, distance, owner, flood, area or protection checks. Best-case values are hypotheses.

options.label: Keep them on hold
options.description: Keep sites with unresolved critical gaps out of the ranking.

options.label: Show conditional upside
options.description: Assume favourable critical checks and rank those sites separately.

questions.prompt: Should we explore sites with unresolved land checks?
questions.help: Legal clearance and remaining usable area must be checked. Confirmed protected sites are always excluded.

options.label: Keep them on hold
options.description: Wait for protection or area conflicts to be resolved.

options.label: Show pending-check scenarios
options.description: Explore a legal footprint and the reported remaining area without restoring sold land.

ranking_contract.ties: Equal scores share a competition rank; site ID orders display only.
ranking_contract.groups: Eligible and conditional sites have separate rankings; held and excluded sites are unranked.
ranking_contract.interaction: Answers change assumptions, never source evidence or confirmation status.
